decisions.statement: Where the index sits is asked of `index-reading` rather than spelt here.
A file under the index folder is passed over.
A file beside a page is judged.
A file is judged from its own body alone.
Every string a body has is read rather than the specifiers alone.
The index folder's name counts only where it is a whole path segment.
A name the index folder's name only ends, as an `index` page's file does, is not seen.
A path built from anything but plain strings is not seen.
The use a caller makes of a path the caller was given is not judged.

definition: the check refusing code outside the index folder that spells a path into the index
